output.population: 242 women over the age of 50 years old who had their fallopian tubes removed during a benign gynecologic procedure; 70 with at least 5 years of oral contraceptive use, 172 without
output.summary: Digital slide images of fallopian tube p53 signatures and precursor lesions of high grade serous cancer, from a retrospective study comparing long-term oral contraceptive users with non-users.
